about: Jun's feature registry (foundations #31). Every feature, big or small, declared once. The settings home builds search, the Simple/Everything layers, 'More' folds, resets, 'turning this off also…' notes and the new-features card from it; the gate (js/core/gate.js, api/lib/gate.php) reads each entry's tier. Keys are 'kind:name' (see 'stores'). Read by js/core/features.js and api/lib/gate.php. A new feature adds its entry here FIRST (CLAUDE.md, Definition of done).

stores.fx: desktop.fx in localStorage (js/desktop/fx.js, defaults in FX_DEFAULTS)
stores.desk: desktop.json desk settings, through junDesktop.desk() (desktop/main.js DEFAULTS.desk)
stores.mirror: a control in her window's settings drawer, mirrored by js/app/home-bridge.js
stores.comfort: the comfort table on her server (api/comfort.php)
stores.local: a plain value in localStorage (the key after 'local:')
stores.feature: a plain on/off in jun.features (localStorage), for new features: Features.isOn(id)
stores.env: her .env file (not changed from the settings)
